verdict: Paid campaigns have been fully paused nine days; pipeline needs attention.
narrative: All Meta advertising stopped on August 6th and has remained dark for nine consecutive days, bringing new lead flow to zero for the current week. The 53 leads and $1,400.53 in spend reported this period all came from the three weeks prior to that pause. Organic website traffic is holding — sessions surged 86% week-over-week, suggesting your brand still draws search interest even without paid support — but that interest is not converting into pipeline. Separately, 43 contacts logged this period produced zero booked appointments, which means the intake process needs to be reviewed alongside any restart of paid activity. Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and the intake workflow is being audited so that new leads move forward when volume returns.
